proposed_statement_changes.reason: The former specification required a strict extension of ordinary hedge completeness but did not force the positive, nonfunctional branch to embed the actual ordered ID recursion. The replacement narrows the class of admissible affirmative answers by requiring a trace-preserving bisimulation, exact seven-case priority and side conditions, suppression of support-specific and functional rules on that branch, compiler agreement, and the corrected failed-subquery scope. It changes no causal-model hypothesis and preserves every latent-lifting, support, rationality, certificate, and complexity obligation.

The current proposition asserts a reduction even though the frozen construction handles contain no productions, transition relation, or expression compiler. The replacement retains exactly the hypotheses \(W=\varnothing\) and full observed-cell positivity, but records the result as the deferred corollary of the mandated embedding invariant and states the case \((5)\) hedge conclusion only for the actual failed subquery, with the original-query conclusion in the corrected existential-subquery form.

open_obligations.what_is_open: Construct a finite causal partial-trace grammar and compiler satisfying the newly explicit classical-ID bisimulation invariant, prove that every residual nonclassical failure lifts source by source to an exact-support pair of independent-root models, prove the converse guarded-formula reconstruction, and derive the required functions \(H(L)\), \(B_{\mathrm{rat}}(L)\), search-state bound, checking-time bound, and certificate-length bound.
open_obligations.obstruction: The frozen trace and algorithm definitions are construction handles rather than production rules. More fundamentally, after latent marginalization, equal observed laws impose polynomial equations on two products of root simplices. The single-model support oracle supplies rational realizations separately, but does not preserve the cross-model equal-law equations; merging the roots would violate the required latent-source architecture. Thus neither a local-to-global independent-source lift nor a rational witness in every separating fiber follows from the frozen primitives.
open_obligations.attempted: I retained the prior reduction of fixed deterministic skeleton pairs to multilinear observed and interventional polynomials and tested the common-reached-row perturbation used in the fully observed proof. It stops because a common observed law does not identify common root masses or primitive response rows. I also decomposed the mandated positive, nonfunctional branch into the seven ordered ID cases and specified the required state relation, compiler behavior, and failure payload; without concrete grammar productions there is no transition system against which to prove the bisimulation. Generic real elimination and latent-source flattening were not used because each misses an explicit requirement of the target.

open_obligations.what_is_open: Instantiate the deferred induction by supplying the concrete restricted grammar productions, compiler, state embedding, and provenance updates required by the narrowed latent-lifting specification.
open_obligations.obstruction: Strict positivity and \(W=\varnothing\) eliminate the new support and functional branches, but they do not manufacture a transition relation from \(\mathrm{def:trace-grammar-handle}\) or \(\mathrm{def:fids-handle}\). Until the open question supplies those data, there is no grammar call tree, no compiler output, and no case \((5)\) payload to compare with ordinary ID.
open_obligations.attempted: I formulated the induction over the seven ordinary ID cases and isolated its base and recursive obligations. Each obligation reduces to one direction of the required trace-preserving bisimulation or to compiler preservation, so proceeding further would assume the missing invariant rather than derive it.

prose_updates.tldr: The paper asks for a complete support-aware analogue of the ID algorithm, \(\operatorname{FID\text{-}S}(G,\Omega,W,\Pi,x,y)\), for finite latent DAGs with supplied observed alphabets, qualitative functional nodes, and declared positive or zero observed events. Its bounded partial-trace grammar must either refute the declarations, derive a guarded formula for \(P_x(y)\), or lift a local obstruction to two exact-support rational SCMs with the same observed law while preserving \(\Omega\) and the independent latent-source architecture of \(G\). An affirmative construction must additionally contain a trace-preserving embedding of the seven ordered Shpitser--Pearl ID cases on exactly the branch \(W=\varnothing\) with every observed cell positive; no support-specific or functional rule may fire there, successful compilation must reproduce the ordinary ID expression, and a failure payload must retain the actual failed subquery and its original-query provenance. The fully observed frontier and the supported-bow separation are available, but the general independent-source latent lift, rational equal-law witness theorem, converse formula reconstruction, finite grammar, certificate syntax, and explicit complexity bounds remain open. Accordingly, the classical-reduction proposition is deferred as a corollary of the missing embedding rather than asserted from the present construction handles.

project_justification.fill: A completed \(\operatorname{FID\text{-}S}(G,\Omega,W,\Pi,x,y)\) procedure must preserve \(\Omega\), exact support, functional-row provenance, and the latent-source architecture of \(G\) through recursion and certify every terminal outcome with a guarded formula, a contradiction, or a rational separating pair obeying explicit primitive and total bit bounds. On the nonfunctional full-support branch, the grammar must embed the seven ordered ordinary ID cases by a trace-preserving bisimulation, compile the same expression, and retain the failed subquery and original-query provenance at a hedge terminal. This invariant makes the classical reduction a derived sanity corollary once the concrete productions and compiler are constructed; it is not supplied by the current handles.

prose_updates.related_work: Shpitser and Pearl supply the recursive seven-case ID algorithm and its hedge completeness argument. The required classical branch here must preserve that recursion state-for-state, not merely agree with its final answer. In particular, a line-five failure must carry the actual failed call and \(\operatorname{FAIL}(G,G[S])\); its payload must certify the hedge at the failed query or subquery, Theorem 17 then certifies nonidentification there, and the conclusion transported to the original query has the corrected Theorem 19 scope: an appropriate subquery with outcome and intervention sets contained in those of the original query has a hedge. The present kernel additionally requires every nonclassical countermodel pair to preserve the declared exact support, supplied observed alphabets, qualitative functional rows, and the independent latent-source architecture of \(G\), with no shared root-mass requirement. Chen and Darwiche's Theorem 15 gives functional-variable elimination under its stated separability and parent conditions, and Theorem 18 assumes the treatment-marginal positivity set \(C_V=\{\Pr(X)>0:X\text{ is a treatment variable}\}\); neither handles arbitrary declared zero-and-positive support literals. Their constrained-identifiability work gives arithmetic-circuit invariant-cut tests, while their 2026 Theorems 1--2 give sound formula-returning algorithms for context-specific independences and state-alphabet constraints under a strictly positive observational law; neither supplies the present complete exact-support rational-countermodel trichotomy. Kivva, Mokhtarian, Etesami, and Kiyavash prove sound-and-complete gID under positivity of the observational law, not on arbitrary declared support faces. Tikka, Hyttinen, and Karvanen motivate provenance-preserving branching but do not provide the required completeness theorem. Fraser informs support consistency, Rosset, Gisin, and Wolfe inform sourcewise cardinality bounds, and finite response-coordinate work informs polynomial encodings; none establishes the missing support-preserving independent-source rational lift.
prose_updates.technical_internal_limitation: The fully observed completion argument does not survive marginalization: equality of observed laws becomes a system of polynomial equalities in products of latent-source probabilities, so a local target-varying direction need not factor into independent sources, and a real separating fiber need not contain a rational point. In addition, the current trace and algorithm definitions are handles, not a production system, so even the classical full-support branch has no transition relation or compiler on which to prove the mandated seven-case bisimulation. These are open obligations, not assumptions.
prose_updates.honest_scope: The support oracle and fully observed completion frontier are established, and the supported-bow pattern has an explicit formula branch and exact rational separating pair. The general finite grammar, terminal-certificate syntax, support-preserving independent-source latent lift, rational equal-law witness theorem, converse guarded-formula reconstruction, kill-instance audit against concrete productions, and explicit functions \(H(L)\) and \(B_{\mathrm{rat}}(L)\) with search and checking bounds remain open. The classical-ID reduction is also deferred until concrete productions and a compiler satisfy the required trace-preserving embedding of all seven ordered cases; equality of final expressions alone is insufficient. A failure pair is scoped to its actual failed query or subquery, and only the corrected existential-subquery hedge conclusion is carried back to the original query. Generic real quantifier elimination, unrestricted latent flattening, and the fully observed special case do not resolve the latent headline.

statement_notes.justification: This is the theorem-level kernel: besides the exact-support independent-source lift and converse formula reconstruction, an affirmative solution must recover ordinary ID by a trace-preserving embedding of its ordered recursive calls on the nonfunctional full-support branch.
statement_notes.gap: The frozen handles provide neither grammar productions nor a compiler. The single-model support oracle does not preserve the polynomial equal-law constraints between two products of latent root simplices, so it cannot supply the required rational paired lift. Moreover, final-answer agreement with ordinary ID would not establish the mandated transition-level bisimulation or the corrected failed-subquery hedge provenance.
statement_notes.consumer: Resolving the question yields auditable formula, contradiction, or countermodel certificates while guaranteeing that existing ordinary-ID behavior, including failure provenance, is preserved exactly on its native branch.

statement_notes.justification: This is a deferred sanity corollary of the classical-ID embedding invariant, to be proved by induction on the bisimilar ID call tree after the open construction supplies concrete productions and a compiler.
statement_notes.gap: The present construction handles do not define grammar transitions, compilation, or failure payloads. Consequently the proposition cannot yet be proved without assuming the missing open construction, and its hedge conclusion must remain scoped to the actual failed subquery with only the corrected existential-subquery conclusion for the original query.
statement_notes.consumer: Once the latent-lifting question is affirmatively resolved, ordinary-ID users obtain the same recursive trace and normalized formula on successful inputs and an auditable, correctly scoped failure certificate otherwise.
